leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Present Simple
leadIn.content: Daily routines and facts: Every day, Anna drinks coffee, works at a bank, and walks her dog in the evening.

instructionCheck.question: Do you select one correct option or write full sentences in this quiz?

meaningCheck.question: "She works in a bank." — Is she working in the bank right now at this exact second, or is it her regular job?
options: It is her permanent regular job / habit
She is inside the bank building right now
She worked there in the past
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Present simple describes permanent states, routines, and habits.

meaningCheck.question: "I eat breakfast at 8 AM." — Does this mean I am eating breakfast right now?
options: Yes, you have food in your mouth right now
No, it is a daily routine that happens regularly
No, it only happened once yesterday
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Present simple expresses routines, not current in-progress actions.

form.title: Form & Structure: Present Simple
form.content: I/you/we/they + base verb. He/she/it + verb-s. Negative: don't/doesn't + base verb. Question: Do/Does + subject + base verb?

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation Notes: Present Simple
pronunciation.content: Spoken stress, weak forms, intonation, and articulation patterns for Present Simple.

controlledPractice.question: 'She ___ in a school.'
controlledPractice.explanation: He/she/it takes the -s form in present simple: works.

controlledPractice.question: Negative of 'He likes tea.'
controlledPractice.explanation: He/she/it uses doesn't + base verb in negatives.

controlledPractice.question: Question form: '___ she like pizza?'
controlledPractice.explanation: He/she/it questions use 'does' + base verb: Does she like pizza?
